artworks.title: Apollo in the Forge of Vulcan
artworks.description: An oil painting of the moment Apollo, crowned with laurel, arrives at the forge to tell Vulcan that his wife Venus is betraying him with Mars. Velazquez renders the smith god and his stunned assistants with striking naturalism, pausing mid-labor over the glowing metal. Painted during the artist's first Italian journey, it hangs in the Museo del Prado, Madrid.

artworks.title: The Temple of Hephaestus, Athens
artworks.description: A Doric temple overlooking the ancient Agora of Athens, dedicated to Hephaestus and to Athena as patrons of crafts. Built in the fifth century BC, it is among the best-preserved of all ancient Greek temples, its colonnade and much of its sculptural decoration still standing.

artworks.title: Thetis Receiving the Weapons of Achilles
artworks.description: An oil on canvas showing the sea nymph Thetis receiving from Hephaestus the divine armor forged for her son Achilles, the episode recounted in Book 18 of the Iliad. Van Dyck stages the exchange amid attendant figures and putti at the god's forge. The painting is in the Kunsthistorisches Museum, Vienna.

films.title: Clash of the Titans
films.description: Harryhausen's forge-god arms the hero: mechanical owl, divine shield and the workshop that equips Perseus for Medusa and the Kraken.

films.title: Hercules
films.description: Disney's Hephaestus is the burly smith of Olympus, hammering out gadgets and one-liners in the gods' armory — the craftsman as comic relief with a forge.

films.title: Fantasia
films.description: Disney's Pastoral Symphony casts him as Vulcan at the forge, hammering thunderbolts for Zeus to hurl — the smith god as cartoon armorer of Olympus.

films.title: The Adventures of Baron Munchausen
films.description: Gilliam's fantasy lands the Baron in Vulcan's Etna forge, with Oliver Reed as the smith god — Hephaestus as volcanic host in a baroque fever dream.

films.title: Wrath of the Titans
films.description: Bill Nighy's Hephaestus is the fallen forge-god who built Tartarus — the craftsman as weary exile, still the only smith who can arm Perseus against the Titans.

popCulture.title: Hades II
popCulture.creator: Supergiant Games
popCulture.description: Hephaestus joins the Olympian boon roster as the god of the forge: armor, blast and Volcanic trade for Melinoë's war on Chronos.

popCulture.title: God of War III
popCulture.creator: Santa Monica Studio
popCulture.description: Rip Torn's Hephaestus forges weapons for Kratos in Tartarus, then dies defending Pandora — the smith god as tragic father in the Spartan's god-killing war.

popCulture.title: Immortals Fenyx Rising
popCulture.creator: Ubisoft
popCulture.description: Ubisoft's myth sandbox makes Hephaestus a major Olympian ally — the forge-god as quest-giver and craftsman in a living Greek theme park.

popCulture.title: Percy Jackson & the Olympians
popCulture.creator: Rick Riordan
popCulture.description: Riordan's Hephaestus is the greasy, brilliant god of forges — father of Leo Valdez, keeper of automaton workshops from Etna to Mount St. Helens.

music.title: The Loves of Mars and Venus
music.description: Weaver's ballet turns on Vulcan's net: the forge-god catching Mars and Venus in the act — Hephaestus' revenge danced as the plot's mechanical punchline.

music.title: EPIC: The Musical
music.description: Rivera-Herrans' 'God Games' gives Hephaestus a sung turn on Olympus — the smith among Athena's divine opponents in the Odyssey concept album.
